description: Strip the three dead-for-help per-command --help guards (config, claude, triage) left unreachable by the CAM-211 central guard.

userStories.title: Remove dead-for-help guards in config, claude, and triage switch cases
userStories.description: As a cam-cli maintainer, I need the three unreachable-for-help --help guard blocks inside the command switch removed so that the dispatch code no longer carries dead code that the central --help guard already supersedes.
acceptanceCriteria: config's dead block is removed: the `if (tail.includes('--help') || tail.includes('-h')) { process.stdout.write(CONFIG_HELP); return 0; }` inside `case 'config'` (index.ts ~2553-2556) no longer exists. [oracle: file-assert: `awk '/case .config.: \{/{f=1} f&&/CONFIG_HELP/{print}' index.ts` prints nothing]

claude's dead block is removed: the `if (parsed.help) { process.stdout.write(CLAUDE_HELP); return 0; }` inside `case 'claude'` (index.ts ~2753-2756) no longer exists. [oracle: file-assert: `awk '/case .claude.: \{/{f=1} f&&/case /&&!/case .claude./{f=0} f&&/CLAUDE_HELP/{print}' index.ts` prints nothing]

triage's dead block is removed: the `if (tail.includes('--help') || tail.includes('-h')) { process.stdout.write(TRIAGE_HELP); return 0; }` inside `case 'triage'` (index.ts ~2823-2826) no longer exists. [oracle: file-assert: `awk '/case .triage.: \{/{f=1} f&&/TRIAGE_HELP/{print}' index.ts` prints nothing]

Surrounding non-help logic in config is preserved: the `--show` parsing, unknown-flag error, and `runConfig({ show: showFlag })` call remain. [oracle: grep -q 'runConfig({ show: showFlag })' index.ts]

Surrounding non-help logic in claude is preserved: the `parseClaudeArgs(argv.slice(3))` call and `runClaude({ args: parsed.forwardedArgs })` call remain (only the help conditional is stripped). [oracle: grep -q 'runClaude({ args: parsed.forwardedArgs })' index.ts]
Surrounding non-help logic in triage is preserved: the tail-length unknown-option error and `dispatchTriage()` call remain. [oracle: grep -q 'return dispatchTriage();' index.ts]
`cam config --help` still prints CONFIG_HELP via the central guard. [oracle: bun index.ts config --help | grep -qi 'usage']
`cam claude --help` and `cam claude -h` (leading) still print CLAUDE_HELP via the central guard. [oracle: bun index.ts claude --help | grep -qi 'usage' && bun index.ts claude -h | grep -qi 'usage']
`cam triage --help` still prints TRIAGE_HELP via the central guard. [oracle: bun index.ts triage --help | grep -qi 'usage']

A non-leading `--help` passed to claude is still forwarded to the child process, not intercepted (leading-only rule in isHelpRequested is unchanged). [oracle: reviewer-judgment: confirm isHelpRequested's claude branch still uses tail[0] leading-only match]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single-file cleanup in index.ts. CAM-278 (Command union + narrowing + exhaustive default switch restructure) is already merged to main (commit 8246531a), so base on current main; line numbers in the issue spec (2258/2458/2529) are pre-CAM-278 and have shifted — current locations are config 2553-2556, claude 2753-2756, triage 2823-2826. Central guard lives at index.ts:2501-2507 (isHelpRequested + HELP_REGISTRY lookup). GOTCHAS: (1) do NOT remove the `parseClaudeArgs(argv.slice(3))` line at 2752 — parsed.forwardedArgs is consumed by runClaude at 2757; only strip the `if (parsed.help){...}` block. (2) do NOT touch config's --show parsing / unknown-flag error or triage's tail-error + dispatchTriage(). (3) Verify each --help by actually running it (bun index.ts <cmd> --help), not by assuming — comments can be stale. Cleanup only, zero behavior change.
